duplicatedCoreModules.reason: Question selection and scoring are calculated on demand; active sessions live in the shared database, not a module cache.
Conjugation explanations are derived from static verb-pair hints; the module keeps no user-data cache.
Weekly metrics are calculated from query results on demand; no user records are cached in the module.
Reports are read from and written to the shared database on each call; the module keeps no report snapshot.
Only public voice-index content and package-local audio handles are cached; user preferences are read live and no study data is cached.
The canvas and file sequence are temporary rendering state scoped to a page bundle, not persisted user data.
Dictionary matches are computed from the supplied database rows; results are not retained in a module cache.
Share and save operations use the image passed to each call and retain no mutable user state.
Question groups and results are derived from the shared database on demand; there is no module-level user-data cache.
The WeakSet records only an idempotent legacy-migration marker per DB object; position values remain in the shared database.
Timer state is passed immutably between calls and belongs to the mounted page, not a module singleton.
Timer state and intervals belong to each mounted React hook instance; no shared module state is retained.
Grammar form matching is a pure calculation over the supplied grammar point.
Memoized values are deterministic lookups over bundled title-furigana content, not user data.
The module reads bundled grammar key-point content and retains no mutable user state.
Study totals are queried from the shared database on demand; query results are not cached.
Ordinal maps are derived only from bundled grammar records and are safe package-local content caches.
The helper schedules a paint yield and retains no state.
Notes are read from and written to app-wide localStorage on every call; this module has no in-memory note cache.
